description: Tapjoy offerwall / rewarded-content SDK (acquired by ironSource 2021, now part of Unity). Distributed standalone from the Tapjoy Maven repo (com.tapjoy:tapjoy-android-sdk); also pulled in by LevelPlay/AdMob/MAX Tapjoy adapters, which all go through Tapjoy.connect

obfuscation.internal_prefix: short letter/letter+digit names in com.tapjoy.internal (dj, cl, h2, w2) and, since 13.x, in com.tapjoy itself (com.tapjoy.a .. com.tapjoy.r0)

methods.name: connect
methods.note: Main SDK init — static boolean connect(Context,String[,Hashtable[,TJConnectListener]]), all 3 overloads return boolean in 11.x-14.x. Stub skips TapjoyConnectCore, TJSession auto-tracking and currency setup; TJConnectListener is never called back

methods.name: limitedConnect
methods.note: static synchronized boolean limitedConnect(Context,String,TJConnectListener) — 12.x/13.x only (13.x already a deprecated no-op that fires onConnectFailure); removed in 14.x

methods.name: requestTapjoyConnect
methods.note: Internal connect request (static in 11.x-13.x, instance in 14.x, always void). Backstop in case Tapjoy.connect is bypassed

methods.name: requestContent
methods.note: Load placement content. Trade-off: unstubbed, it already fires onRequestFailure('SDK not connected') when connect is stubbed; stubbing suppresses all TJPlacementListener callbacks

methods.name: trackPurchase
methods.note: IAP tracking — every overload void (2 or 4 String args in 11.x-13.x; (String,double) etc. in 14.x)

methods.name: trackEvent
methods.note: Custom event analytics — 9 void overloads in 11.x-13.x, removed in 14.x

methods.name: RequestOWDiscover
methods.note: Unity/engine-plugin bridge for Offerwall Discover, 13.x+, both overloads void

manifest_components.note: GCM push receiver (11.x, declared by the app when push is used)
App-usage (usage-stats) foreground service in 14.x — not in the AAR manifest, present only if the app declares it

protected_patterns.reason: Tapjoy.getPlacement returns a TJPlacement that app code dereferences (requestContent/showContent) — null causes NPE. Works fine without connect
TJPlacementManager.createPlacement / TapjoyNative.createPlacement (JNI bridge) return the placement object — null causes NPE
Apps call Tapjoy.getPrivacyPolicy().setUserConsent()/setSubjectToGDPR() before connect — null causes NPE
TapjoyConnectCore/TJPrivacyPolicy singletons — dereferenced by the SDK's own graceful not-connected paths and by app consent code
Returns Set<String> that app code may iterate — null causes NPE
Returns Activity reference — null causes NPE
